limitations: Environmental representation is a spatial coverage proxy at the nearest captured qualification analysis, not a causal attribution of individual traffic.
Endpoint and junction counts are raster-graph proxies; eight-neighbor staircases can inflate junction counts.
Three deterministic seeds at one 600 s horizon do not establish a general distribution.

metricDefinitions.bornPlates: Only actual plate-birth events; Sphere births excluded.
metricDefinitions.footprintArea: Binary frozen mask cell count divided by 95^2.
metricDefinitions.networkCells: Frozen centerline vertex count; network links are compiled Plate edges.
metricDefinitions.priorUnionOverlap: Mask cells already in the union of earlier born Plates.
metricDefinitions.environmentCoverage: Cumulative frozen Plate mask coverage of current chemicalMemory >= 0.3, supported cells >= 0.015, their intersection, and cells with at least one FOOT_CONTACT.
